# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository is a Bank of China PPT generation workspace.

When a user asks to create content pages, cover/chapter/TOC pages, or assemble a final PPT, follow the canonical workflow:

```text
skills/boc-ppt-builder/AGENT.md
```

Do not improvise project paths. Use `raw_files/`, `ppt_plan/`, `ppt_chapters/`, and `ppt-master/` exactly as documented in the workflow.
